panels.title: Registered indicators (latest day in range)
panels.description: Number of indicator instruments (one row each) in the B3 Indicator Instruments file (BVBG.029.02, `b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse` parquet) on the most recent trading day in the time range, plus how many distinct assets they cover. Filtered by the time range and the `asset` variable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT count(*)::BIGINT AS indicators, count(DISTINCT asset)::BIGINT AS assets
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)

panels.title: Registered indicators per day
panels.description: Daily count of indicator instruments listed in the BVBG.029.02 file, stacked by asset (`daily_parse` parquet, grouped by trading date and asset). Filtered by the time range and the `asset` variable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, count(*)::BIGINT AS indicators
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE asset IN ($asset)
  AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Indicator register (latest day in range)
panels.description: Every indicator instrument on the most recent trading day in the range, with its asset, descriptions, instrument name and ID, and the indicator codes from the file (type, base, value type, decimal precision, maturity). Source: `daily_parse` parquet, sorted by asset and description. Filtered by the time range and the `asset` variable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT asset,
  description,
  indicator_description,
  instrument_name,
  instrument_id::VARCHAR AS instrument_id,
  indicator_type_code,
  base_code,
  value_type_code,
  decimal_precision,
  maturity_code
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY asset, description

panels.title: Indicators added / removed (within range)
panels.description: Indicator instruments (tracked by instrument ID) that first appear after the first day in the range ('added') or are gone by the last day ('removed'), with their first and last dates seen. One that appears and disappears within the range is listed only as 'added'. Filtered by the time range and the `asset` variable.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE asset IN ($asset)
    AND $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
b AS (
  SELECT min(trad_dt) AS first_day, max(trad_dt) AS last_day FROM d
),
s AS (
  SELECT instrument_id,
    arg_max(asset, trad_dt) AS asset,
    arg_max(description, trad_dt) AS description,
    arg_max(indicator_description, trad_dt) AS indicator_description,
    min(trad_dt) AS first_seen,
    max(trad_dt) AS last_seen
  FROM d
  GROUP BY instrument_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN s.first_seen > b.first_day THEN 'added' ELSE 'removed' END AS status,
  s.asset,
  s.description,
  s.indicator_description,
  strftime(s.first_seen, '%Y-%m-%d') AS first_seen,
  strftime(s.last_seen, '%Y-%m-%d') AS last_seen
FROM s, b
WHERE s.first_seen > b.first_day
  OR s.last_seen < b.last_day
ORDER BY greatest(s.first_seen, s.last_seen) DESC, s.asset, s.description

panels.title: Assets with most indicators (latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 20 assets by number of indicator instruments on the most recent trading day in the range, with one sample instrument name per asset (`daily_parse` parquet). Only the time range applies; the `asset` variable does not filter this panel.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_indicator_instruments/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT asset,
  any_value(instrument_name) AS instrument_name,
  count(*)::BIGINT AS indicators
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY asset
ORDER BY indicators DESC, asset
LIMIT 20
